digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: Verified CI wall-clock time increased from 15-20 minutes to 30-40 minutes, driven by macOS default tier pytest growth of +870.72s due to ~4.1k additional tests added between commits ceea743 and 7a1863f

Multiple unit tests execute expensive production mechanics (120s timeout budgets, captured real sleeps, retries, backoff timers) that can be replaced with fake/injected values without reducing coverage
Mutation testing contribution was measured at 0s critical-path addition across 62 post-mutation runs with only 5/62 selecting active mutation, making it not the root cause of the observed regression

macOS job execution exhibits nonlinear contention-amplified subprocess/APFS workload behavior when combined with org-wide GitHub Free runner limits (5 concurrent macOS jobs), not solely deterministic test growth
Wiki corpus test cache is filled once per xdist worker rather than once per session, causing redundant recomputation and 300+ aggregate seconds of wasted time in recent runs

Seven decomposed remediation tickets (albinic-kyanite-goldeneye, coed-defectible-muskox, analogical-dashing-fennecfox, harmless-wavy-osprey, curricular-mean-cuckoo, despotic-dorsal-greatdane, classless-dainty-lamprey) target the identified slow tests while preserving coverage and rejecting previously-rejected parallelism approaches
